control_failures.control_label: arc flash boundary and protective equipment

facts.title: unplanned release of electrical energy at SG-7000

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control ARC_FLASH_PPE_AND_BOUNDARY: the arc flash boundary and protective equipment was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the arc flash boundary and protective equipment on SG-7000 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in controlling access to energised apparatus, specifically switching, racking and access authorisation. SG-7000 (terminal switchgear) is in service for terminal distribution. The task proceeded during an intrusive maintenance task while the arc flash boundary and protective equipment was in place but did not perform. The electrical energy involved is held as HV switchgear, and the recorded presentation was shock, arc flash, unplanned energisation.
response.summary: On 12 November 2022 a high potential incident was recorded on SG-7000 at Cape Verity Export Terminal during an intrusive maintenance task; electrical energy held as HV switchgear was not released.
